designNotes: One email per credited or refunded session; language by nationality group; status stored on the customer.

cases.title: A credited session sends exactly one email in the customer's language

steps.action: Mark "Đã tập" for a Vietnamese customer
steps.expected: Exactly 1 email is listed under "Emails sent", in Vietnamese, with its sending status

assumptions: The foreign-group language is taken to be English; the sources say only "the language of their nationality group".
cases.manualReason: Involves email delivery outside the browser.

cases.title: Repeating the status change does not send a second email

steps.action: Send the "Đã tập" action twice for the same session
steps.expected: Still exactly 1 email for that session

cases.manualReason: Needs two simultaneous requests and email inspection.
